page.layout: One printed page: a single full-width block of italic and roman text at the top, followed by centred lines below it (a note, a closing word, and the printer's signature). No margins, running head or page number.

main_text.p: totius Provinciæ situm artifice dextrâ delinea- tum exhibet. Quod meum studium, operam, curam, Nob. v. Ampl. gratam acceptamque fore, ut nullus dubito, sic me meaque omnia, earundem Ampl. Vest. patrocinio & favori, unicè cupio esse commendata. Groningæ Erif.[?] Nonis Martiis. CIↃ IↃC XLVI.

page.notes: The scan is faded and speckled, with stains on the lower half. The date is printed as CIↃ IↃC XLVI, transcribed as MDCXLVI. "Erif." is doubtful: it may be a printed abbreviation or a damaged word, so it is marked [?]. The word "Quod" is underlined in the print, which I have kept as <u> markup but which the schema does not define, so the underline is shown only as a marker. A faint digitiser watermark in the bottom right corner has been left out.
